W.note: Quiet Hours hero button lifts about 2px onto a soft lavender glow with a 680ms tail, restrained and calm, with focus ring, reduced-motion fallback, and a still-hover toggle all in place.

X.note: Hollowmere's Browse stays button visibly drifts its gradient toward pink and magenta with a long violet bloom on hover, the most ethereal hover in the set, with hover gated to pointer devices and reduced motion honored, though the placeholder gradient cards are a bit generic.

Y.note: Moodboard's hover reads as a glossy white sheen band sweeping across the dark button more than as dreamlike light, the aura breathes on an infinite loop, and the hover rule is not gated to pointer devices so touch can stick.

Z.note: Lantern and Lake uses a pre-blurred glow layer with a 420ms float curve returning about 1.25 percent, a tunable lift-curve editor, press and focus responses, and a motion scale for reduced motion, though the captured hover frames only show the disabled button so the main button's motion is inferred from source.
